items.review_rationale: Read the entire étale ring-map characterization, including the requirement of finite presentation and vanishing of both homology degrees of the naive cotangent complex, not merely formal unramifiedness.

references.context: Homological algebra: first homology module of a two-term cotangent complex

references.disposition: Both vanishing conditions are explicitly required; no additional étaleness-at-prime condition is inferred.

items.review_rationale: Read the complete categorical equalizer property, identifying parallel arrows and equality after precomposition, and the universal uniqueness of factorization through the equalizing arrow.

references.context: Category theory: unique factorization of any arrow equalized by the given pair

references.disposition: This equality is the defining equalizing equation, and the universal part additionally requires unique factorization.

items.review_rationale: Examined the entire directed-set definition, retaining reflexivity and transitivity of the underlying preorder, nonemptiness and the common upper bound quantifier; antisymmetry is not required.

references.disposition: This is an explicit nonemptiness requirement rather than an assumption that an empty preorder is directed.

references.phrase: for any i,j there is k with i≤k and j≤k
references.disposition: The common upper bound is the defining directedness condition and does not add antisymmetry.

items.review_rationale: Read the full direct-system definition: objects indexed by a preorder, transition arrows for every comparable pair, identity transitions and compatible composition. No filteredness or directedness of I is asserted in this formulation.

references.disposition: These are the functorial transition equations for the indexed system, not a demand for isomorphic arrows.
